name: carousel
pattern: Slide navigation and automatic rotation following the APG Carousel Pattern
responsibility: Switches slides through consumer-authored buttons and provides roledescription, hidden, data-state, cancelable change events, and automatic rotation. Does not generate positioning, transitions, or content.

authorMarkup.root: Any element with data-controller="carousel", named through aria-label or aria-labelledby. The consumer chooses a role determining whether it is a landmark.
authorMarkup.slide: At least two data-carousel-target="slide" elements, each named through aria-label or aria-labelledby. A positional name such as "3 / 10" is acceptable when no unique descriptive name exists.
authorMarkup.play: A native <button type="button"> with data-carousel-target="play", toggling rotation with one button rather than separate start/stop buttons. Required when interval > 0.
authorMarkup.label: Consumers supply button labels and update play-button wording from data-state. APG requires wording to reflect state, but the library cannot infer the wording.
authorMarkup.content: The controller generates no elements or content. Consumer CSS controls positioning, transitions, and stacking.

semanticElements: At least two slide targets are required.
previous, next, and play targets must be HTMLButtonElement elements with type="button".
At most one previous, next, and play target is allowed for each kind.
The root must have an accessible name.
Every slide must have an accessible name.
Exactly one play target is required when interval > 0.
contractValidation.invalidMarkup: Validate markup and values on connection. Invalid configuration prevents ARIA, listeners, timers, state outputs, and slide operations and warns once per connection. Do not throw.
contractValidation.warning: Warnings identify carousel controller and the invalid element type or value name.

completion.warning: The completion warning lists the added attributes: "Added <attributes>. Include them in your markup." It is emitted once while connected, using a separate flag from the enhancement-disabled warning

index.description: Index of the slide to display

interval.description: Automatic rotation interval in milliseconds. Zero disables rotation. A positive interval requires a play target to provide a WCAG 2.2.2 stop control.

index.description: Index of the visible slide. Assignment changes visibility and state outputs without custom events.

next().description: Show the next slide, wrapping last to first, without custom events.

previous().description: Show the previous slide, wrapping first to last, without custom events.

play().description: Start automatic rotation without emitting a custom event for the call.

pause().description: Stop automatic rotation without custom events.

carousel:beforechange.when: Before a slide change from trusted interaction or automatic rotation
carousel:beforechange.effect: On preventDefault(), leave visibility and state outputs unchanged and do not emit carousel:change.

carousel:change.when: After a slide change from trusted interaction or automatic rotation is committed

events.timerReason: Automatic rotation uses reason="timer". Although not directly initiated by user input, it emits events so consumers can observe visible-slide changes.
events.programmatic: index assignment, next(), previous(), play(), pause(), initialization, and reconnection emit no custom events.
events.sameIndex: Do not emit beforechange/change when the index is unchanged.
events.synthetic: Clicks with isTrusted=false change visibility/state outputs without custom events.

consumerIntegration.stimulusActions: Listen for carousel:change and carousel:beforechange on the root or ancestors. The controller does not stop propagation.
consumerIntegration.cancelableHook: Cancel switching with event.preventDefault() in a carousel:beforechange listener.
consumerIntegration.programmatic: Other controllers may use index, next(), previous(), play(), and pause() through a Stimulus controller reference or outlets. Programmatic calls emit no events.
consumerIntegration.nested: Use :self or event.target === event.currentTarget to restrict events to the root when listening outside nested carousels.

behavior.autoplay: Rotate only when interval > 0. The default is zero, with rotation stopped.
behavior.focusPause: Stop rotation when focus enters any element inside the root. Do not resume when focus leaves; users resume through the play target.
behavior.reducedMotion: Do not inspect prefers-reduced-motion. Consumers decide whether to rotate through interval and play().
behavior.keyboard: Use native previous/next/play button activation; do not implement carousel-specific arrow keys.
behavior.tabbed: The APG tabbed-carousel variant is outside scope. Consumers apply both controllers when composing with tabs.
behavior.wrap: Next from the last slide wraps to the first; previous from the first wraps to the last.
behavior.indexClamp: Normalize out-of-range, negative, fractional, or non-finite index values to zero and write the normalized index back to the Stimulus value.
behavior.indexFallback: If slide changes leave the current index out of bounds, clamp to the final slide. When the visible slide is removed, show the slide now at the same index, or the last slide if none exists there. This correction emits no custom events.
behavior.playToggle: Play-target activation stops running rotation or starts paused rotation; one button serves both actions.

managedMarkup.root: Supply role="group" and aria-roledescription="carousel" on the root only when each attribute is absent.
managedMarkup.slide: Supply role="group" and aria-roledescription="slide" only when absent; synchronize hidden on nonvisible slides.
managedMarkup.stateOnly: Only root, slide, and play-target data-state are controller-managed state outputs.
managedMarkup.preservation: Preserve authored id, role, aria-roledescription, aria-label, and other attributes. The controller synchronizes hidden.

stateOutputs.ownership: Only root/slide/play data-state are controller-owned visual state outputs; do not use ARIA for styling state.
stateOutputs.play: data-state="playing" or "paused"; consumers use it to update the rotation-control label.

lifecycle: Register previous/next/play click and root focusin listeners in connect(); remove them in disconnect().
Cancel the rotation timer on disconnect().
Track slide additions/removals through Stimulus TargetConnected/TargetDisconnected.
Leave generated ARIA, data-state, and hidden on disconnect().
Synchronize ARIA/state with current markup on reconnection without restarting rotation.
Do not duplicate listeners, timers, or custom events when reconnecting the same instance.

observations.impact: The contract fixes slide semantics and user-controlled rotation; announcement wording does not determine the public API.

acceptanceCriteria: The behavior and accessibility implemented by this component must meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA.

Required AAA criteria: 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception), with no pointer-only features; and 3.2.5 Change on Request, with controller focus movement limited to user actions or consumer JS calls, never timers.
Trusted interaction and rotation emit one cancelable beforechange followed by one committed change, in that order.
Canceling beforechange preserves visibility/state and suppresses change.
Require the play target when interval > 0, guaranteeing a WCAG 2.2.2 stop control.
Focus inside the root stops rotation.
Public API calls, initialization, and reconnection synchronize visibility/state without custom events.
The controller does not own positioning, transitions, or stacking.
Invalid markup disables enhancement with one warning
Pass automated tests in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
Report real-device screen reader announcements of aria-roledescription as unverified.
